caption: The drawing depicts a brown cast-iron wood or coal stove set against a plain, light beige background. The stove has four short legs and a rectangular body with two ornate, relief-patterned doors on the front and side, each with radiating sunburst designs centered around oval shapes. The top of the stove features three circular openings. At the front, there is an extended rectangular metal tray or platform, also supported by two short legs, positioned just below the main stove door. The stove appears textured with detailed shading to illustrate its metallic and decorative qualities. The name "Edmond P. Riets" is written in small letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Cast Iron Toy Stove
